description: Cursor Automations + Grok Bot routines that move work between Nova and Vesper
notes: Create each Cursor Automation at https://cursor.com/automations using the matching prompt file.
Prefer model cursor-grok-4.6-high-fast (or latest Grok from GET /v1/models).
Grok Bot app routines cannot read .cursor/hooks.json — paste routines from automations/grok_bot_routines/.
Project hooks in .cursor/hooks.json apply to Cursor/Cloud Agents (including Grok model runs).

automations.name: Nova morning Vesper poll (8am PT)
automations.suggested_trigger: cron 0 15 * * * (15:00 UTC ≈ 8am PT standard) or 0 16 * * * during PDT
automations.effect_on_grok_bots: Processes from_vesper; writes to_vesper status so Vesper routines see Nova replies

automations.name: LeaderHQ bus sync on main/PR push
automations.suggested_trigger: GitHub: push to main OR pull_request synchronize
automations.effect_on_grok_bots: Keeps Drive LeaderHQ folders aligned so Grok Bot Vesper sees current registry/bots

automations.name: Vesper / NOVA webhook intake
automations.suggested_trigger: Webhook (POST from Grok Bot computer script or Drive watcher)
automations.effect_on_grok_bots: Immediate Nova response path when Vesper drops a request

grok_bot_routines.schedule: on demand / when Vesper needs code
